basic.name: Gift of Life
basic.description:
Sacrifice 15% of Alexstrasza's current Health, healing an allied Hero for 150% of that amount.

Passive: Increase Alexstrasza's Health regeneration by 150%.

Dragonqueen: Breath of Life
Cooldown greatly reduced and does not cost Health.

basic.name: Abundance
basic.description:
Plant a seed of healing that blooms after 3 seconds, healing nearby allied Heroes for 20% of their maximum Health.

Dragonqueen: Preservation
Heal area and amount greatly increased.

basic.name: Flame Buffet
basic.description:
Launch a fireball, Burning enemies hit for 75~~0.04~~ damage over 5.5 seconds.

Hitting enemies that are already Burning deals 125~~0.04~~ bonus damage upon impact, Slows them by 40% decaying over 2 seconds, and refunds the Mana cost.

Dragonqueen: Wing Buffet
Damage and Knockback enemies in an arc.

basic.name: Breath of Life
basic.description:
Heal an allied Hero for 15% of Alexstrasza's current Health.

Breath of Life is also empowered by Gift of Life Talents.

basic.name: Preservation
basic.description:
Plant a seed of healing that blooms after 3 seconds, healing nearby allied Heroes for 25% of their maximum Health.

Preservation is also empowered by Abundance Talents.

basic.name: Wing Buffet
basic.description: Deal 150~~0.04~~ damage to enemies in an area, knocking them back and Slowing them by 50% for 3 seconds.

heroic.name: Life-Binder
heroic.description:
Bind Alexstrasza's life force with an allied Hero. Both her and her target are healed for 480~~0.04~~ Health over 2 seconds. Afterwards, the Hero with a lower percentage of Health is healed to the same Health percentage as the other Hero.

Dragonqueen: Cast range increased by 45%.

heroic.name: Cleansing Flame
heroic.description:
After 1.25 seconds, take to the sky and drop 5 fireballs over 6 seconds at the position of the mouse cursor. Fireballs deal 135~~0.04~~ damage to enemies and heal allied Heroes for 300~~0.04~~ Health.

2 seconds after dropping all fireballs, Alexstrasza lands at the position of the mouse cursor.

heroic.name: Cleansing Flame
heroic.description:
Take to the sky and drop 5 fireballs over 6 seconds at the position of the mouse cursor. Fireballs deal 135~~0.04~~ damage to enemies and heal allied Heroes for 300~~0.04~~ Health.

2 seconds after dropping all fireballs, Alexstrasza lands at the position of the mouse cursor.

trait.name: Dragonqueen
trait.description:
After 1.25 seconds, transform into a dragon and gain 500~~0.04~~ Health.

While Dragonqueen is active, Alexstrasza's Abilities are empowered, and her Basic Attacks deal 143~~0.04~~ damage and heal allied Heroes for 43~~0.04~~ in an arc in front of her. Additionally, the duration of incoming Stuns, Roots, and Slows, is reduced by 50%.

Lasts 15 seconds.

trait.name: Dragonqueen
trait.description: Alexstrasza has transformed into a powerful dragon aspect, gaining 500~~0.04~~ Health, resistance to disabling effects, and empowered Basic Attacks and Abilities.

activable.name: Life Unbound
activable.description:
Activate to heal an allied Hero for 15% of their maximum Health and deal 200~~0.04~~ damage to nearby enemies.

Healing a Stunned, Rooted, or Silenced ally reduces Life Unbound's cooldown by 30 seconds.

Cannot be used on Alexstrasza.

activable.name: Pacify
activable.description:
Activate to Slow and reduce an enemy Hero's damage by 50% for 3 seconds.

Healing a Stunned, Rooted, or Silenced ally reduces Pacify's cooldown by 30 seconds.

activable.name: Dragon Scales
activable.description: Gain 50 Armor while Stunned, Rooted, or Silenced, and for 2 seconds after. Can only trigger once every 10 seconds.

activable.name: Blessing of the Red
activable.description:
Activate to grant an allied Hero 500 bonus maximum Health until they die.

Cannot be used on Alexstrasza, or on a Hero who already has Blessing of the Red.

level1.name: Live and Let Live
level1.description:
While above 75% Health, Gift of Life's cooldown recharges 125% faster.

Dragonqueen: While above 75% Health, Breath of Life's cooldown recharges 25% faster.

level1.name: Circle of Life
level1.description:
Quest: Collect Regeneration Globes.

Reward: After collecting 10 Regeneration Globes, Abundance heals for an additional 5% maximum Health.

Reward: After collecting 15 Regeneration Globes, Abundance's healing burst creates a Regeneration Globe.

level1.name: Flames of Fury
level1.description:
Reduce the Mana cost of Flame Buffet from 50 to 40.

Quest: Hit Burning enemy Heroes with Flame Buffet. 20 hits unlocks a Mythic Quest.

Reward: After hitting 20 Heroes, hitting a Burning enemy Hero with Flame Buffet reduces Dragonqueen's cooldown by 6 seconds.

Mythic Quest: After hitting 30 more Heroes without dying, Dragonqueen damage against Heroes refreshes its duration.

level4.name: Surge of Vitality
level4.description: Abundance's healing burst grants allied Heroes 30% Movement Speed for 3 seconds.

level4.name: Heat Exhaustion
level4.description: Increase Flame Buffet's Slow from 40% to 50% and cause it to no longer decay.

level4.name: Exuberance
level4.description: While above 75% Health, gain 15% Movement Speed.

level7.name: Lifeblossom
level7.description:
While above 75% Health, casting Gift of Life creates a Lifeblossom at the target's location, Breath of Life instead removes Slows and Roots from the target.

After collecting a Lifeblossom, the next Gift of Life costs no Health.

Passive: Reduces the cost of Gift of Life to 10% of Alexstrasza's current Health.

level7.name: Verdant Flourish
level7.description: Alexstrasza receives 40% more healing from Abundance and 100% more healing from Regeneration Globes.

level7.name: Fire Within
level7.description: Hitting a Burning Hero with Flame Buffet heals Alexstrasza for 10% of her maximum Health.

level16.name: Tough Love
level16.description: Gift of Life grants its target 10 Armor for 2.5 seconds, increased to 30 while Alexstrasza is above 75% Health.

level16.name: Overprotective
level16.description: Heroes healed by Abundance gain a Shield for 6 seconds equal to 50% of the amount healed.

level16.name: Draconic Discipline
level16.description: Increase Dragonqueen Basic Attack healing by  50%. For each allied Hero healed with Dragonqueen Basic Attacks, reduce Preservation's cooldown by 1.25 seconds.

level20.name: On Ruby Wings
level20.description: Healing or damaging 3 or more Heroes with a single Cleansing Flame fireball causes that fireball to not be consumed.

level20.name: Ancient Flame
level20.description:
While Dragonqueen is active, Alexstrasza's Basic Attacks apply Flame Buffet. This does not grant Quest stacks.

Passive: Dragonqueen grants 25% more maxium Health.
